name: KGL3Predicates
title: Knowledge graph L3: predicates
description: The predicates of the L3 layer. An edge's `predicate` is one of these; which (source, target) pairs each licenses is the layer's edge table. Source: smart-base/L1/schemas/L3.ts (migrated from smart-kg ontology/L3/L3.json).

concept.definition: An L2 component is implemented by a FHIR artefact. Reused from l1 and licensed here per (component, resource) pair transcribed from the published mapping table. ALWAYS `inferred`, never `derived`: with no back-pointer extension in the estate, the join is a naming convention or a canonical reference, and every instance records which rule matched and a resolutionStatus. The optional `targetPath` property on an instance names the element reached (e.g. `PlanDefinition.action[2]`) so traceability can be element-level without this layer modelling FHIR internals as nodes.

A FHIR artefact cites an L1 source through `relatedArtifact[type = #citation]`. The target is an l1:citation minted from the same string by tools/extract-citations.mjs, so L3 and L1 join without either extractor knowing about the other -- the same mechanism l2-dmn uses from a decision rule.

One FHIR artefact references another by canonical: a PlanDefinition its Library, an action its ActivityDefinition, a Questionnaire its StructureMap, a Measure its Library. These are real canonical references rather than conventions, so unlike implementedBy they are `derived` when read straight from the field.
